arxiv-1904-03480.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Masatoshi Hirabayashi, Eri Tatsumi, Hideaki Miyamoto, Goro Komatsu, Seiji Sugita, Sei-ichiro Watanabe, Daniel J. Scheeres, Olivier S. Barnouin, Patrick Michel, Chikatoshi Honda, Tatsuhiro Michikami, Yuichiro Cho, Tomokatsu Morota, Naru Hirata, Naoyuki Hirata, Naoya Sakatani, Stephen R. Schwartz, Rie. 162173 Ryugu, the target of Hayabusa2, has a round shape with an equatorial ridge, which is known as a spinning top-shape. A strong centrifugal force is a likely contributor to Ryugu’s top-shaped features.

arxiv-2101-03048.title: Signatures of the charge density wave collective mode in the infrared optical response of VSe 2
arxiv-2101-03048.creator: Xuanbo Feng (馮翾博), Jans Henke, Corentin Morice, Charles J. Sayers, Enrico Da Como, Jasper van Wezel, Erik van Heumen
arxiv-2101-03048.description: Abstract We present a detailed study of the bulk electronic structure of high quality VSe 2 single crystals using optical spectroscopy. Upon entering the charge density wave phase below the critical temperature of 112 K, the optical conductivity of VSe 2 undergoes a significant rearrangement.

arxiv-2101-04434.title: Developing an OpenAI Gym-compatible framework and simulation environment for testing Deep Reinforcement Learning agents solving the Ambulance Location Problem
arxiv-2101-04434.creator: *Michael Allen, Kerry Pearn, Thomas Monks
arxiv-2101-04434.description: Abstract Abstract Background and motivation : Deep Reinforcement Learning (Deep RL) is a rapidly developing field. Historically most application has been made to games (such as chess, Atari games, and go). Deep RL is now reaching the stage where it may offer value in real world problems, including optimisation of healthcare systems.

arxiv-2105-01424.title: On the Linear convergence of Natural Policy Gradient Algorithm A version of this paper was first submitted to a conference in Mar 2021.
arxiv-2105-01424.creator: Sajad Khodadadian, Prakirt Raj Jhunjhunwala, Sushil Mahavir Varma, Siva Theja Maguluri
arxiv-2105-01424.description: Abstract Markov Decision Processes are classically solved using Value Iteration and Policy Iteration algorithms. Recent interest in Reinforcement Learning has motivated the study of methods inspired by optimization, such as gradient ascent. Among these, a popular algorithm is the Natural Policy Gradient, which is a mirror descent variant for MDPs.

arxiv-2210-09605.title: Optimal Phase Design for RIS Channel Estimation
arxiv-2210-09605.creator: Chelsea L. Miller, Peter J. Smith, Pawel A. Dmochowski
arxiv-2210-09605.description: Abstract We develop an optimal version of a prior two-stage channel estimation protocol for RIS-assisted channels. The new design uses a modified DFT matrix (MDFT) for the training phases at the RIS and is shown to minimize the total channel estimation error variance.

arxiv-2302-01836.title: Fermi–LAT Gamma-ray Emission Discovered from the Composite Supernova Remnant B0453–685 in the Large Magellanic Cloud Journal: ApJ CIAO ( Fruscione et al. 2006 , v4.12) , FermiPy ( Wood et al. 2017 , v.1.0.1) , Fermitools: Fermi Science Tools ( Fermi Science Support Development Team 2019 , v2.0.8) ,

arxiv-2302-01836.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jordan Eagle, Daniel Castro, Peter Mahhov, Joseph Gelfand, Matthew Kerr, Patrick Slane, Jean Ballet, Fabio Acero, Samayra Straal, Marco Ajello. We report the second extragalactic pulsar wind nebula (PWN) to be detected in the MeV–GeV band by the Fermi –LAT, located within the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC).

arxiv-2303-07655.title: Simultaneous Action Recognition and Human Whole-Body Motion and Dynamics Prediction from Wearable Sensors
arxiv-2303-07655.creator: Kourosh Darvish, Serena Ivaldi, Daniele Pucci
arxiv-2303-07655.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel approach to solve simultaneously the problems of human activity recognition and whole-body motion and dynamics prediction for real-time applications. Starting from the dynamics of human motion and motor system theory, the notion of mixture of experts from deep learning has been extended to address this problem.

arxiv-2306-10768.title: PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS OF SPOKE RESONATORS, STATISTICS FROM CAVITY FABRICATION TO CRYOMODULE Testing
arxiv-2306-10768.creator: A. Miyazaki, P. Duchesne, D. Ledrean, D. Longuevergne, and G. Olry, CNRS/IN2P3/IJCLab Université Paris-Saclay, 91405 Orsay, France
arxiv-2306-10768.description: Abstract Irène Joliot-Curie Laboratory (IJCLab) has been leading the development of spoke resonators in multiple international SRF projects, from fundamental R&D, prototyping, to series production. The European Spallation Source (ESS) superconducting linac is the first of its kind to put into operation the spoke resonators.

arxiv-2404-00409.title: 3DGSR: Implicit Surface Reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting
arxiv-2404-00409.creator: Xiaoyang Lyu, Yang-Tian Sun, Yi-Hua Huang, Xiuzhe Wu, Ziyi Yang, Yilun Chen, Jiangmiao Pang, Xiaojuan Qi
arxiv-2404-00409.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xiaoyang Lyu, Yang-Tian Sun, Yi-Hua Huang, Xiuzhe Wu, Ziyi Yang, Yilun Chen, Jiangmiao Pang, Xiaojuan Qi. In this paper, we present an implicit surface reconstruction method with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), namely 3DGSR, that allows for accurate 3D reconstruction with intricate details while inheriting the high efficiency and rendering quality of 3DGS. The key insight is to incorporate an implicit signed distance field (SDF) within 3D Gaussians for surface modeling, and to enable the alignment and joint optimization of both SDF and 3D Gaussians.

arxiv-2506-12593.title: Experimental Verification of a Time-Domain Load Identification Method for Single-Phase Circuits
arxiv-2506-12593.creator: Francisco M. Arrabal-Campos, Francisco G. Montoya, Jorge Ventura, Santiago Sánchez-Acevedo, Raymundo E. Torres-Olguin, and Francisco de León
arxiv-2506-12593.description: Abstract This paper presents experimental validation of a time-domain load parameter determination method for single-phase circuits. The verification is performed in a state-of-the-art smart grid laboratory equipped with power hardware and real-time emulators. The proposed method enables the identification of circuit parameters using only instantaneous voltage and current measurements at the point of common coupling.

arxiv-2511-07663.title: Cortex AISQL: A Production SQL Engine for Unstructured Data Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2511-07663.creator: Paweł Liskowski, Benjamin Han, Paritosh Aggarwal, Bowei Chen, Boxin Jiang, Nitish Jindal, Zihan Li, Aaron Lin, Kyle Schmaus, Jay Tayade, Weicheng Zhao, Anupam Datta, Nathan Wiegand, Dimitris Tsirogiannis
arxiv-2511-07663.description: Abstract . Integrating AI’s semantic capabilities directly into SQL is a key goal, as it would enable users to write declarative queries that seamlessly blend relational operations with semantic reasoning. This would allow for effortless querying of both structured and unstructured data. However, achieving production-scale efficiency for semantic operations presents significant hurdles.

arxiv-2602-11898.title: Benchmark Illusion: Disagreement among LLMs and Its Scientific Consequences
arxiv-2602-11898.creator: Eddie Yang, Dashun Wang
arxiv-2602-11898.description: Abstract Benchmarks underpin how progress in large language models (LLMs) is measured and trusted. Yet our analyses reveal that apparent convergence in benchmark accuracy can conceal deep epistemic divergence. Using two major reasoning benchmarks – MMLU-Pro and GPQA – we show that LLMs achieving comparable accuracy still disagree on 16-66% of items, and 16-38% among top-performing frontier models.

pmc-10491681.title: Real-world analysis of survival benefit of surgery and adjuvant therapy in elderly patients with colorectal cancer
pmc-10491681.creator: Lei Zhang, Qixin Li, Chenhao Hu, Zhe Zhang, Junjun She, Feiyu Shi
pmc-10491681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Treatment guidelines for colorectal cancer (CRC) in elderly patients remain unclear. This study aimed to investigate whether elderly patients (≥ 70 years) with CRC benefit from surgery and adjuvant therapy. A total of 90,347 eligible CRC patients older than 70 years were collected from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database and divided into a surgery group and a no-surgery group. After being matched by propensity score matching at a 1:1 ratio, 23,930 patients were included in our analysis.

pmc-10651207.title: Prior Screening for Latent Tuberculosis Among Patients Diagnosed With Tuberculosis Disease: Missed Opportunities?
pmc-10651207.creator: Heidi Fischer, Lei Qian, Zhuoxin Li, Saadiq Garba, Katia J Bruxvoort, Jacek Skarbinski, Jennifer H Ku, Bruno J Lewin, Parag S Mahale, Sally F Shaw, Brigitte C Spence, Sara Y Tartof
pmc-10651207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundCalifornia has the largest number of tuberculosis (TB) disease cases in the United States. This study in a large California health system assessed missed opportunities for latent tuberculosis (LTBI) screening among patients with TB disease.MethodsKaiser Permanente Southern California patients who were ≥18 years old with membership for ≥24 months during the study period from 1 January 2008 to 31 December 2019 were included.

pmc-10746367.title: In silico screening of herbal phytochemicals to develop a Rasayana for immunity against Nipah virus
pmc-10746367.creator: Bishal Debroy, Arkajit De, Somdatta Bhattacharya, Kuntal Pal
pmc-10746367.description: BackgroundThe first emergence of the Nipah virus (NiV) in 1998 from Malaysia became a major concern when it came to light and resurfaced on different occasions thereafter. NiV is a bat-borne zoonotic and pleomorphic virus that causes severe infection in human and animal hosts.

pmc-11360498.title: Sensing Classroom Temperature, Relative Humidity, Illuminance, CO2, and Noise: An Integral Solution Based on an IoT Device for Dense Deployments
pmc-11360498.creator: Wilmar Hernandez, Norberto Cañas, Annie Lanzolla, Jianguo Liu
pmc-11360498.description: Maintaining optimal Indoor Environmental Quality (IEQ) requires continuous measurement of certain variables. To this end, ASHRAE and BPIE recommend that at least the following areas of interest be considered when measuring IEQ: thermal comfort, illuminance, indoor air quality, and noise.

pmc-11606329.title: Nuclear eDNA metabarcoding primers for anthozoan coral biodiversity assessment
pmc-11606329.creator: Luke McCartin, Emma Saso, Samuel A. Vohsen, Nicole Pittoors, Penny Demetriades, Catherine S. McFadden, Andrea M. Quattrini, Santiago Herrera
pmc-11606329.description: The distributions of anthozoan corals are undercharacterized due to their wide bathymetric ranges, occurrences in remote locales, and difficulties of identification from morphology alone. Environmental DNA (eDNA) sequencing promises to be a noninvasive strategy to complement conventional approaches for mapping and monitoring the distribution and biodiversity of coral communities.

pmc-12408379.title: Attosecond control and measurement of chiral photoionization dynamics
pmc-12408379.creator: Meng Han, Jia-Bao Ji, Alexander Blech, R Esteban Goetz, Corbin Allison, Loren Greenman, Christiane P Koch, Hans Jakob Wörner
pmc-12408379.description: Many chirality-sensitive light–matter interactions are governed by chiral electron dynamics. Therefore, the development of advanced technologies making use of chiral phenomena would critically benefit from measuring and controlling chiral electron dynamics on their natural attosecond timescales. Such endeavours have so far been hampered by the lack of characterized circularly polarized attosecond pulses, an obstacle that has recently been overcome1,2.

pmc-12961144.title: Midterm Results of Large-Caliber Tendon Allografting for Chronic Achilles Tendon Rupture With Large Defects
pmc-12961144.creator: Chung-Hua Chu, Hsing-Cheng Wu, Kuang-Ting Yeh, Yu-Wen Huang, Kai-Chiang Yang, Tung-Wu Lu, Chen-Chie Wang
pmc-12961144.description: Background:Chronic Achilles tendon ruptures with large defects present a considerable challenge in treatment.Purpose:This study evaluated the midterm outcomes of fresh-frozen large-caliber allograft reconstruction for chronic Achilles tendon ruptures.Study Design:Case series; Level of evidence, 4.Methods:A total of 32 patients (18 women and 14 men), with a mean age of 57.6 years (range, 21-81 years), were enrolled between 2007 and 2021.

pmc-13175283.title: Bilateral Mandibular Simple Bone Cysts: A Report of an Unusual Case
pmc-13175283.creator: Christina Zagkou, Konstantina-Eleni Alexiou, Konstantinos Katoumas, Nikolaos Kolomvos, Christos Angelopoulos
pmc-13175283.description: Simple bone cysts are intraosseous cavities that are surrounded by bony walls, and they are either empty or contain liquid and/or connective tissue. They have similar radiological findings to those of true cysts, but they do not have an epithelial lining and are thus regarded as pseudocysts. They are frequently asymptomatic and most often an incidental finding on radiographic examination.

pmc-13372169.title: Identification of tooth traces from a Cretaceous (Maastrichtian) Edmontosaurus annectens bonebed in the Lance Formation, Wyoming, U.S.A.
pmc-13372169.creator: Bethania C. T. Siviero, Elizabeth Rega, Matthew A. McLain, Leonard R. Brand, David Nelsen, Art V. Chadwick, Furqan A. Shah, Furqan A. Shah, Furqan A. Shah
pmc-13372169.description: Identifying the origin of perforating lesions on fossil bone is often difficult, and many are considered tooth traces, in spite of more likely and more parsimonious etiologies. Much of this confusion stems from tooth trace criteria that are ambiguous when the context for the lesions is not considered.

pmc-13583938.title: Too little, too late? The burden of delayed care in NTDT
pmc-13583938.creator: Khaled M. Musallam, Thomas D. Coates, Ali T. Taher
pmc-13583938.description: initiation of regular transfusion therapy after specialist evaluation, whereas substantial proportions had already developed iron overload, pulmonary hypertension, thrombosis, endocrine complications, or extramedullary hematopoiesis by the time they reached expert care.1 Importantly, these observations are not unique to the United States.

pmc-13589402.title: Long-Read Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Reveals Dynamic Isoform Changes During Corneal Epithelial Wound Healing in Cynomolgus Monkeys
pmc-13589402.creator: Le-Chun Ou, Ming Zhou, Hu Chen, Zhi-Bo Huang, Yuan-Xia Yang, Shi-Da Chen, Feng Zhang, Ying-Feng Zheng, Zhuo-Xing Shi
pmc-13589402.description: PurposeCorneal epithelial wound healing is essential for visual recovery after injury, yet the molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Different RNA isoforms from the same gene may have distinct functions not captured by gene-level analyses. This study characterized isoform-level transcriptional changes during corneal epithelial wound healing in cynomolgus monkeys using long-read single-cell RNA sequencing (RNA-seq).

uslaw-usc-t42-s4901.title: 42 U.S.C. § 4901 — Congressional findings and statement of policy
uslaw-usc-t42-s4901.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s4901.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 65 (Noise Control). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Congress finds— (1) that inadequately controlled noise presents a growing danger to the health and welfare of the Nation’s population, particularly in urban areas; (2) that the major sources of noise include transportation vehicles and equipment, machinery, appliances, and other products.
